description: Boundary coverage for shared-context caching across repeated waves. Loads threaded through a shared loading context are satisfied by one batched round-trip on the first wave; subsequent waves repeating the exact same loads are served entirely from the context cache and trigger no further round-trips. The reported signals are the total number of round-trips across all waves and the linked-record id set returned to each owner in each wave, including owners with no links and waves repeated more than twice.
